title: When Agents Coordinate: Measuring Coordination in Multi-Agent AI Coding
abstract: arXiv:2608.16801v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study how teams of AI coding agents coordinate while solving programming tasks. Current evaluations usually report whether the agents complete the task and how much the run costs, leaving the coordination inside the team largely unmeasured. We introduce an instrument to measure this coordination. Each run is represented as a temporal network in which agents and files are nodes, and messages, file writes, and file reads are timestamped directed edges with an associated cost. We apply this instrument to 1902 runs, each evaluated with a fixed test suite, across configurations that vary the team size, the team structure, and the file policy. The resulting networks show how coordination changes as teams grow and as the work changes. Direct messaging initially increases close to quadratically with the number of agents, with much of this growth coming from an early round of introductions. translated_title: 当代理协调时：衡量多代理AI编码中的协调性
translated_abstract: 我们研究了AI编码代理团队在解决编程任务时的协调方式。当前的评估通常只报告代理是否完成任务以及运行成本，而团队内部的协调在很大程度上未被测量。我们引入了一种工具来衡量这种协调性。每次运行被表示为一个时间网络，其中代理和文件是节点，消息、文件写入和文件读取是带有时间戳和关联成本的有向边。我们将该工具应用于1902次运行，每次运行都通过固定测试套件进行评估，并变化团队规模、团队结构和文件策略等配置。生成的网络展示了协调如何随着团队增长和工作变化而改变。直接消息传递最初随着代理数量的增加接近二次方增长，其中大部分增长来自早期的一轮介绍。随着团队进一步扩大，这种增长趋于平稳。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于时间网络的新工具来量化多代理AI编码团队的协调行为，并发现直接消息传递随团队规模呈近二次方增长后趋于平稳。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a temporal network-based instrument to quantify coordination in multi-agent AI coding teams, revealing that direct messaging grows near-quadratically with team size before leveling off.
